<body>
  <h1>Chaos game with SVD-described maps, instanced on the GPU</h1>
  <p class="lede">
    Two maps, each pivoted on its own centre c with its linear part written as an SVD,
    <code>A = T(c) &middot; R(u) &middot; diag(s<sub>0</sub>, s<sub>1</sub>) &middot; R(&minus;v) &middot; T(&minus;c)</code>,
    with 0 &lt; s<sub>i</sub> &lt; 1 so the maps contract. The chaos game runs once on the CPU; the GPU then
    draws those points for each of 2<sup>n</sup> instances, instance <code>0110</code> using T<sub>0</sub>&middot;T<sub>1</sub>&middot;T<sub>1</sub>&middot;T<sub>0</sub>.
    Switch on <em>Explore</em> to let centres, rotations and scales wander.
  </p>
